svg.title: Sharding
svg.desc: Sharding. Split data horizontally across databases using a shard key. Step 1, One database at its limit: One database holds every customer: CPU at 95%, the disk 90% full, and writes keep growing. Step 2, Split rows by a shard key: The router hashes customer_id and sends each query to the one shard that holds that customer. Step 3, What the key makes hard: Email lookups hit every shard; one huge customer heats B; an A + C transaction needs 2PC or a saga. Step 4, Add a shard, move only 25%: Disks reach 80%: new shard D takes 3 of the 12 logical shards, so 25% of the data moves, not 75%.
